description: This file contains functions for interacting with an API related to evaluation workflows, including starting evaluations, subscribing to events, fetching status and notes, polling results, and transforming evaluation data. It is specific to the 'rag_evaluation' API endpoints and includes detailed result processing.

methods.name: startAsyncEvaluation
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous evaluation process, registers webhook if available, and returns an execution ID and related info.

methods.name: subscribeToExecutionEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to server-sent events for a specific execution, handling notes, status updates, and errors.

methods.name: fetchExecutionStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current status and result of an execution, with retries for pending/running states.

methods.name: fetchExecutionNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with a specific execution.

methods.name: pollExecutionResult
methods.description: Polls repeatedly for the execution result, emitting new notes, until completion or timeout.

methods.name: evaluateRAG
methods.description: Performs a RAG evaluation by calling the API and transforming the response.

methods.name: evaluateRAGAsync
methods.description: Starts an async RAG evaluation and polls for the result until completion or timeout.

methods.name: transformResult
methods.description: Transforms raw API response data into a structured EvaluationResult, including detailed analysis of hallucinations, faithfulness, relevance, and other metrics.
